sam_cs: Heads up 12 AstraGenomics (trial) requested an APAC peering + temporary QPS lift for an in-region demo. They also want SNI pinning and an allowlist for their client SNI values. Can we triage?

hiro_ops: Hosted API? Need CIDRs, exact window, and QPS targets. SNI pinning is unusual but doable at the proxy layer.

sam_cs: Hosted. Contact: ops@astragenomics.com. Window: 2026-10-06 01:00 -> 2026-10-06 12:00 UTC. Sustained 140 QPS, demo bursts to 520 for 3-5m. CIDRs: 35.240.0.0/16. SNI values: aseast-client.astragenomics.com and aseast-bastion.astragenomics.com. They ask for X-AG-CTX header pin too.

leah_net: We can add allowlist + SNI match rules at edge and validate header equality. Recommend feature flag ff:ag-apac-route, canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Auto-revoke after window. Need NET-3302 peering ticket and a small maintenance push.

noah_pm: Renewal touchpoint in Nov; capture latency, token-cost, and customer feedback. This demo could influence Dedicated interest.

hiro_ops: Risk: 520 bursts risk token spikes and KV cache churn. Propose billing cap $2k for window, enable prefix caching, and an emergency throttle command. I'll prepare this proxy snippet for infra: ```
allowlist_ips:["35.240.0.0/16"]
sni_allowlist:["aseast-client.astragenomics.com","aseast-bastion.astragenomics.com"]
header_whitelist:["X-AG-CTX"]
region_route:"asia-southeast1"
rate_limit_override:{"sustained_qps":140,"burst_qps":520,"window":"2026-10-06T01:00Z/2026-10-06T12:00Z"}
auto_revoke:true
```

auto-bot: Ticket created CS-3319: "AstraGenomics APAC SNI allowlist + demo QPS bump". Owners: hiro_ops, leah_net. Calendar event added.

hiro_ops: I'll verify SNI match semantics and whether TLS passthrough preserves SNI for our edge. If not, fallback to header HMAC check. Plan: validate CIDR & consent today, T+1 create canary 5%, monitor p95 latency and token burn, then ramp.

noah_pm: I'll prepare an eval checklist (p50/p95 latency, token-cost delta, SNI routing correctness, header mismatch rate, customer survey). Attach results to CS-3319 and include notes for the Nov renewal.

sam_cs: I'll send acceptance + data handling consent and confirm they accept the $2k cap and auto-revoke. Ask them to provide any certificate/key details needed for SNI verification if required.

leah_net: After the window we'll revoke allowlist and revert route automatically. Export usage snapshot for billing and flag any egress fees.

hiro_ops: Adding runbook snippet: `rb throttle cs-3319 --qps 60` and on-call tag.

sam_cs: Closing loop 12 once canary is green we'll request explicit go/no-go from Astra. Thanks everyone. :pray:
